_doc: How far a place is from a civilisation's home tiles, banded onto the reach levels (../reach_levels/). The days themselves come from geography's fastest route over the modes the civilisation holds (sim/geography/reach_bands.py).

entries.unit: days of the fastest route from a held tile
entries.source: Labelled heuristic: about a week's travel is still inside the home trading sphere (reach level 1). Not fitted to a source.
entries.why: Sets where the reach levels begin on the days of the fastest route; each later level takes a fixed multiple of it.

entries.unit: days of one reach level per days of the one before
entries.source: Labelled heuristic: each step of the reach scale (own trade routes, coastal sailing, deep voyage, ocean crossing) is a doubling of the journey. Not fitted to a source.
entries.why: Turns days of travel into the reach level that gates expeditions and prices distant materials.

entries.source: The located materials' cost_multiplier figures were written for Rome (located_materials.json note).
entries.why: Their cost multipliers are what a kilogramme costs the civilisation they were authored for at its start; other civilisations pay more or less as their own reach differs.
